summary: A college-aged man fell an estimated 80 to 120 feet from a rock formation he was climbing in Eldorado Canyon State Park, suffering serious bodily injuries; found on the ground near the Wind Tower formation by rescuers after a 7:40 p.m. 911 call; RMRG members helped carry him to a nearby fire station where a helicopter flew him to the St. Anthony Hospital trauma center in Denver.
location: Wind Tower, Eldorado Canyon State Park
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain Rescue Group; Boulder County Sheriff's Office
notes: Daily Camera (BCSO Sgt. Dave Booton) account via Firehouse, published 2014-03-20; incident Wednesday night 2014-03-19.
